name: XRAG
description: XRAG is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' generation abilities in cross-lingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation settings, focusing on scenarios where user language differs from retrieval results. It covers monolingual and multilingual retrieval with relevancy annotations and requires complex reasoning.
reputation: XRAG is a very recent benchmark and is not yet broadly established, but it targets an important emerging setting for cross-lingual RAG evaluation.
notes: Constructed from recent news articles; reveals challenges in response language correctness and cross-lingual reasoning.
